svg.aria-label: Daily doodle for July 21, 2026 — 127th birthday of Ernest Hemingway (born July 21, 1899, Oak Park, Illinois). A warm-lamplit writer's desk with a vintage Corona portable typewriter on the left, a sheet of paper rising from it with the typed line 'The old man was thin and gaunt with deep wrinkles.', a tumbler of amber whiskey and a stack of manuscript pages beside it, curls of cigar smoke drifting up, a pewter compass, and a silver marlin leaping over a distant sea horizon through a window on the right. A large ivory JULY 21, 2026 headline sits in the lamplight on the right, with a sepia HEMINGWAY · 127 YEARS subhead and italic OAK PARK · 21 JULY 1899 · THE ICEBERG BENEATH tertiary along the bottom.

g.text: The old man was thin and gaunt

svg.text: OAK PARK · 21 JULY 1899 · THE ICEBERG BENEATH
